11/7/16

Shanghai Municipal Council.

July 11th 1916.

POLICE FORCE.
(DETECTIVE BRANCH)

Sir,
Owing to a second landslide on the Shanghai Nanking
Railway line the train service was discontinued from 11 p.m.
9th to 8 a.m. 10th inst.
Tsou Ching Tsung 周金 Shanghai Taoyin is said to
have tendered his resignation. There is a report that
Sung Pao Tsang 沈保昌 City Magistrate, will take his place.
The Kuomintang party are opposed to Sung and say that
he is a pro-monarchist.
Zau Li Wang 赵立王 one of General Yang's staff officers
an Arsenal Magistrate, and two officers of the City Police
left for Nanking at 11 p.m. 10th inst.

Your Obedient Servant,

Chief Detective Inspector.

Captain Superintendent of Police.

1916年7月11日

上海工部局。

1916年7月11日。

警务处
（侦探股）

先生：

由于沪宁铁路线发生第二次山体滑坡，列车服务自本月9日晚11时起至10日上午8时止暂停。

据称，上海道尹周金（Tsou Ching Tsung）已提出辞呈。有消息称，上海县知事沈保昌（Sung Pao Tsang）将接替其职位。国民党反对沈保昌，称其为拥戴君主制者。

杨将军的一名参谋、兵工厂厂长赵立王（Zau Li Wang，音译），以及两名市警察官员，于本月10日晚11时前往南京。

您忠实的仆人，

总探长

警务处总监
